messages:
alex_cheung: Hey team — quick sync on the FinEdge connector preview cohort. Enrollment is 4/28-5/05 and we currently have 4 of 6 seats claimed. Need to lock down enablement plan, feedback capture, and identify any renewal-risk signals up front.

maria_ops: thanks Alex. i can lead the onboarding sessions, recommending two 30m hours: one intro + one follow-up deep-dive. available windows: 4/29 10:30–11:00 or 4/30 16:00–16:30 PT. which do folks prefer? :calendar:

julian_cs: prefer 4/29 morning. also can we get customers to run a short eval checklist during the follow-up? things like latency on 512 tokens, average tokens per request, and a couple of functional prompts. would capture regressions early.

alex_cheung: yes — Julian's checklist sounds perfect. i'll draft a one-pager checklist and share. also want to surface risk metric: if a customer reports >2 failed workflows or token cost > expected by 25% during preview, flag for renewal ops.

sam_platform: FYI — i've provisioned a staging model alias for the cohort: alias finedge-preview-v1. Staging token + brief runbook here: https://redwood.example.com/preview/finedge (internal)

sam_platform: runbook snippet: ```bash
# use the preview alias
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PREVIEW_TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"model":"finedge-preview-v1","input":"Summarize transaction trends for Q1"}'
```

maria_ops: perfect. can we add a short guided prompt set in the runbook? 6 prompts max so customers can do the eval in ~15 minutes. i'll build slides for the 4/29 session.

julian_cs: adding note — we'll capture qualitative feedback in a Google Form but also pull quantitative metrics from the console: mean latency, p50/p95, token-usage per session. i'll create the console dashboard and share snapshot link.

kelly_pm: heads-up on renewal risk: one of the two trial seats from FinEdge was flagged earlier for high support volume. if they push back on cost or latency we'll need to propose dedicated pooling + batching config. i'll draft two proposals (cost-first, latency-first) and pin pros/cons.

alex_cheung: thanks Kelly — good to have proposals ready. action items: (1) maria = schedule and slides for 4/29; (2) julian = dashboard + eval form by 4/27; (3) sam = publish runbook + preview token before 4/26; (4) kelly = draft renewal mitigation options by 5/03; (5) alex = one-pager checklist + enrollment reminder emails.

onboard-bot: Enrollment webhook triggered: 2 new seats claimed (users: finedge-admin1, finedge-qa). Timestamp: 1795043405.

maria_ops: booked 4/29 10:30–11:00 PT and sent invites to the enrolled users. session link in calendar invite. :white_check_mark:

julian_cs: shared initial dashboard (internal): https://redwood.example.com/dashboards/finedge-preview — will add p95 traces by EOD 4/27.

alex_cheung: quick note on feedback capture phrasing — please ask customers to rate statements on a 1–5 scale: "response relevance", "latency acceptability", "integration friction", and free-text for blockers. short is better.

maria_ops: copied, will include in slides and form.

kelly_pm: will circulate draft mitigation options in the doc and tag @alex_cheung and @julian_cs for cost/latency tradeoff input.

alex_cheung: super — thanks everyone. i'll send the enrollment reminder tomorrow with the checklist link. if any blockers, post here. :rocket:
